title: The Day the School Bus Went Rogue
description: A wild ride with a very unusual bus driver

fields.prompt: What is a verb ending in -ing?
What would you yell when surprised?

template:
It was a {adj1} Monday morning, and {friend} was waiting for the school bus. But when the bus finally pulled up, something was very wrong. The driver was a giant {animal} wearing sunglasses!

"All aboard!" said the {animal}. "Next stop: {place}!"

{friend} climbed the steps and sat down. The seats were made of squishy {food}, and every time the bus hit a bump, it went {noise}! Before anyone could say a word, the whole bus started {verbing} down the road at {number} miles per hour.

All the kids screamed, "{exclaim}" and threw {pluralnoun} out the windows. A police car chased after them, but the {animal} just honked the horn and said, "Catch me if you can!"

The bus zoomed up a hill, flew off a ramp, and soared right over the school. {friend} held on tight with both hands and one {bodypart}. Down below, the principal looked up and dropped her coffee.

Finally, the bus landed in the school parking lot with a giant {noise}. The {animal} hopped out, tipped its hat, and said, "Sorry I'm late. I got lost on the way to {place}."

The teacher didn't even look up from her desk. "Take your seats," she said. "And {friend}, please stop {verbing} in the hallway."

It was the best Monday ever.
